responsibility: Implements gm2’s post-quad deferred checking engine for subranges, bounds, pointer validity, type compatibility, and arithmetic runtime conditions. It stores pending check descriptors indexed by kind and referenced symbols, derives min/max information from Modula-2 and GCC types, folds constant cases, emits GCC `Tree` tests and handler calls through `m2expr`, `m2statement`, and `m2builtins`, and reports semantic problems such as incompatible types, missing CASE coverage, or impossible bounds with source-aware diagnostics and runtime exception hooks from `M2Base`.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file realizes the deferred checking subsystem by keeping range-check descriptors, computing bounds and compatibility, and emitting GCC trees and handler calls; the same-name `.def` file is only the exported interface to those checks.
